locked_design.population: LongMemEval answerable strata, EC-001 seed 5005 ranks 21-30
locked_design.target: has_answer marker aggregated to strict user-assistant exchange
locked_design.event: mean teacher-forced NLL of rendered user-content tokens
locked_design.independence: target exchange excluded from prior and next event scores
locked_design.adjustment: OLS residual for token count, model-token IDF, exchange position, and preceding rendered tokens

gates.G2: adjusted symmetric AUC >= 0.60 and permutation p <= 0.01
gates.G3: raw symmetric AUC >= 0.55 and adjusted AUC >= raw AUC - 0.02
gates.G4: prior and next AUC each >= 0.55 and absolute difference <= 0.10
gates.G5: at least five of six stratum AUCs > 0.50 and none < 0.45

authorization.measurement: conditional on a committed passing PF1-PF10 artifact
authorization.accessibility_study: conditional on G1-G5; separate pre-registration required
